tools.name: list_schemas

tools.name: list_tables

tools.name: run_query
tools.justification: SELECT/WITH only; INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DROP/ALTER/TRUNCATE/CALL/GRANT and multi-statement payloads are rejected before reaching IRIS (see sql_guard.py and its test suite).

tools.name: vector_search
